name: Algebra 1 Course Bank Profile
role: Course-specific authority for the canonical Mastery Goal -> exact I Can -> high-quality Question Family Bank architecture. The Bank is a reusable family/generator source, not a finished-question warehouse.

question_structure.rule: Use current universal Question Structure for every authored Bank family exemplar unless the task is a direct read/execute job that should stay direct.
question_structure.semantic_fit_rule: Evidence job, student action, structure, response mode, representation mode, and executable route must agree.
question_structure.direct_read_rule: When the evidence job is only to read, identify, name, estimate, or extract a feature from a supplied representation, keep the task direct rather than adding artificial critique or construction.

mastery_goal_source_rule: The exact Unit Assessment Plan is primary authority. assessment_plans/indexes/assessment_plan_index.json is the coursewide retrieval aid.

bank_architecture.organizing_unit: Mastery Goal -> exact I Can -> Question Family
bank_architecture.family_count_policy: No fixed A/B/C count. Aim for about 8-10 materially different high-quality families per I Can; about 6 may be sufficient for narrow I Cans; exceed 10 only when another family genuinely adds a worthwhile student job.
bank_architecture.family_label_rule: Existing stable letter labels remain valid IDs. A/B/C/D... do not imply Intro/Review/Mastery or difficulty and do not carry a universal semantic role.
bank_architecture.material_difference_rule: A new family must change how students demonstrate the I Can. Number/name/noun/context swaps alone do not create a new family.
bank_architecture.fresh_instance_rule: Downstream products select an approved family and instantiate a fresh question by changing only allowed variation axes while preserving the family invariant, evidence job, representation demand, and usable difficulty.

offline_generation.direction: Prefer deterministic/local instantiation when the family can support it safely.

levels.STATIC: Strong family architecture/exemplar; fresh instances may still require semantic authoring.
levels.PARAMETERIZED: Script safely varies declared values/data/context tokens while preserving architecture.
levels.DETERMINISTIC: Script can reproduce prompt/representation/answer/solution and permitted distractors from stored seed/parameters.

offline_generation.quality_rule: Do not force a rich family into full deterministic generation when that would reduce quality.

student_label_rule: When a Bank-derived question is shown in a targeted student artifact, display exact canonical I Can code + full exact I Can statement, e.g. U1-MG03-IC01 — Substitute a value for a variable.

delivery_rules.notes: Resolve the Bank owning the exact current Intro I Can and instantiate an instructional family parallel for Example/YTI.
delivery_rules.practice: Use mastery_recurrence_map.json and teacher-approved target plans; instantiate fresh questions from approved families.
delivery_rules.activities: Use the same selected target plan as the paired Practice surface but fresh families/instances.
delivery_rules.quick_check: Teacher approves four source architectures per section; generate fresh A-D siblings with safe deterministic variation.
delivery_rules.practice_builder: Generate/select unique approved instances for teacher/student-selected I Cans; prefer deterministic family generation when available.
delivery_rules.checkpoint: Portfolio decides what evidence is useful now; Bank supplies approved question-family architecture.
delivery_rules.review: Use approved nonsecure families and recurrence targets; do not create a second Bank.
delivery_rules.summative: Use secure-appropriate family/blueprint architecture and reviewed deterministic siblings when safe.

response_mode.game_exception: selected response only when an explicit game/export route authorizes it
